summary: Recent crime data from Boise State University reflects a notable increase in reported incidents, particularly in theft and alcohol-related violations. The latest report includes several theft cases, including a hit-and-run incident and multiple alcohol violations resulting in referrals. Compared to previous months, the frequency of thefts has risen, while alcohol-related offenses remain consistent, indicating ongoing concerns around campus safety. Additionally, the resolution of some cases through arrests suggests active law enforcement engagement, which may contribute to a perceived increase in reported incidents as awareness grows.
